result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major accessibility problem with text contrast in the promotional banner. No other visually broken layout or content was found, excluding the intentionally partially visible horizontal carousel items and bottom-of-viewport content.

issues.description: The promotional banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and its subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white/light text on a very pale mint-green background, making them barely legible with extremely low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or change the headline and subtext to a dark green/near-black color so the text meets at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the background.
